description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller for managing Vehicle entities. It provides endpoints for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting vehicles, with appropriate request validation, response mapping, and API documentation annotations.

classes.name: VehicleController
classes.description: RestController class that handles HTTP requests related to Vehicle entities, including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting vehicles.

methods.name: listVehicles
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all vehicles.

methods.name: getVehicle
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific vehicle by its ID.

methods.name: createVehicle
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new vehicle with validation and mapping.

methods.name: updateVehicle
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing vehicle identified by ID.

methods.name: deleteVehicle
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a vehicle by ID.
